title: Reports: JSON, CSV, D2, and self-contained HTML
objective: Export one versioned graph schema through data, diagram, and bounded interactive HTML formats.
acceptance_criteria: JSON and CSV schemas preserve stable IDs, evidence counts, and query metadata.
D2 and HTML escape every target-controlled string.
HTML uses no remote scripts and enforces explicit large-graph limits.
non_goals: Do not weaken protected contracts, workflow configuration, or unrelated capabilities.
Do not load or execute target classes, builds, plugins, annotation processors, or code.
Do not copy implementation code from the upstream ArchUnit project.
